## Why DO NOT SHIP
Defects #1–#3 are high severity and trivially reproducible on first pass through the app: one boots the user out of the app via a basic list scroll/tap, and two produce incorrect data in exactly the screens (form submission, checkout total) where correctness matters most. These aren't exotic edge cases — they showed up in the very first exploration of each screen."
